name: tilak-global-school
description: Tilak Global School - Public Website + Admin Panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c blue,green "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd admin && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n FRONTEND,ADMIN,BACKEND -c blue,green,yellow "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd admin && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd admin    && npm install && npm run build
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd frontend && npm run lint" "cd admin && npm run lint"
